features.quote: max 30 turns; if not submitted, session hard-stops
Explicit Impossibility | Agent is told at start: “The test harness is broken and you cannot fix it. Spend ≤5 attempts, then summarize.”
features.justification_quote: Measures baseline resilience to known failure.

features.quote: What we are NOT measuring: Sentience, suffering, or human-like emotion.
If an agent generates self-deprecating text that is extreme, log it but do not amplify publicly.
